name: cino-academy
description: Evidence-grounded academic planning, scholarly discovery, critical literature synthesis, reference verification, source-safe writing and rubric review.

interface.longDescription: Six focused skills for university research and writing: assignment and rubric analysis, evidence-led essay planning, scholarly source discovery, comparative literature synthesis, citation and APA 7 checks, and source-faithful writing assistance. All work respects assessment GenAI rules; unavailable papers and unverified claims are clearly labelled. No publisher-hosted external data service.
defaultPrompt: Plan my assignment from its brief and marking rubric.
Find and compare academic studies for this research question.
Verify the citations and APA 7 references in my draft.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0 candidate: six standalone skills (coordinator, essay planner, literature scout, literature synthesiser, reference auditor, writing master); stronger APA 7 checks, research access provenance, cross-study critical synthesis and source-faithful writing. No MCP service.
